_note: Canonical sitting UI copy — the one source for every viewport (web, desktop, VS Code, TUI, CLI). Edit this file; nothing else. Served merged with user overrides at GET /api/ui-copy, and as a JS shim at GET /ui-copy.js (rendered from this file at request time, so there is no generated copy to drift). Python viewports read it through kettle.uicopy.

_fields.text: The string. Titles/heds: Title Case. Body copy and button labels: sentence case or lowercase per docs/UI.md.
_fields.short: Optional terse variant for a narrow surface (TUI status bar, a 2-line pane). Viewports prefer it when space is tight and fall back to text. Same meaning, fewer words — never a different instruction.
_fields.note: Where this string appears and what it is for. Written for a reader (human or agent) who has only the key.
_fields.states: One message per flow state from docs/SITTING-FLOWS.md, in three registers: `line` for a status bar, `short` for one sentence, `full` for a guide. Same meaning, fewer words as the surface narrows — never a different instruction. A viewport renders the register its chrome affords instead of writing its own sentence.

streamIdle.note: Agent pane status when no agent stream is running.

spinWorking.note: Spinner label while an agent turn is in flight.

chatPlaceholder.note: Chat input placeholder on a founded desk.

chatPlaceholderFounding.note: Chat input placeholder during the founding interview (P3).

chatPlaceholderProposing.text: Ask the agent to revise the proposal
chatPlaceholderProposing.note: Chat input placeholder while a Desk Proposal is on the editor (P4).

editorPlaceholder.note: Editor placeholder on a founded desk with no entry open. Intentionally empty.

editorPlaceholderFounding.text: Chat with the agent to establish your project.
editorPlaceholderFounding.note: Editor placeholder during the founding interview; the editor is not the work surface yet.

editorPlaceholderProposing.text: Edit the proposal, then approve it to set up your project
editorPlaceholderProposing.short: Edit the proposal, then approve it
editorPlaceholderProposing.note: Editor placeholder when the Desk Proposal is the open document.

commentPlaceholder.text: A note on this file for the agent to read when you finish this batch — Enter saves · Shift+Enter newline · Esc cancels
commentPlaceholder.note: Comment box placeholder, including its key bindings.

foundingQueueHintTitle.note: Queue empty-state hed during the founding interview.

foundingQueueHintBody.text: Chat with the Kettle agent to set up your project with a queue of files to review.
foundingQueueHintBody.short: Chat with the agent to set up your project.
foundingQueueHintBody.note: Queue empty-state body during founding — says where the work is and what fills the queue.

proposingQueueHintTitle.note: Queue empty-state hed while a proposal awaits Approve.

proposingQueueHintBody.text: Edit the proposal until it matches what you want from this project. Chat with the agent to revise it or write it together. When it looks right, approve it — that sets up your project and lines up the first batch of files to review.
proposingQueueHintBody.short: Edit the proposal, then approve it to set up your project.
proposingQueueHintBody.note: Queue empty-state body while proposing. The short form is what a status bar shows.

noEntryBriefBody.text: Kettle lines up a batch of files for you to review, edit, and approve. When you are done, press Sweep: the agent applies your decisions and lines up the next batch.
noEntryBriefBody.short: A batch of files to review, edit, and approve.
noEntryBriefBody.note: Second line of the brief when a project desk is bound and no queue entry is selected.

queueTitle.note: Hed of the queue pane (left column, top).

metaTitle.note: Hed of the entry-metadata pane (left column, bottom).

metaEditLabel.note: Button in the Info pane hed that switches entry fields to editable.

deskProjectLabel.note: Label beside the project selector in the desk chrome.

approveLabel.note: Ritual control: rules on the open entry. Reads Approve in both states — while a proposal is open, pressing it founds the project desk.

approveLabelFounding.note: The same control while proposing. Same word since 2026-10-01; kept as its own key so a viewport may still differ if it needs to.

approveHint.text: Mark your decision on this file. Nothing changes until you press Sweep.
approveHint.note: Tooltip on Approve. States what it does not do, which is the common misread.
approveHint.short: Mark your decision on this file.

approveHintFounding.text: Approve the proposal to set up your project
approveHintFounding.note: Tooltip on the ritual control while a proposal is open. The label does not change (Approve was retired 2026-10-01); the sitting promotes the control visually instead.

commentLabel.note: Ritual button: open the note box for the open file.

commentHint.text: Leave a note on this file for the agent to act on
commentHint.short: Leave a note for the agent

commentTiedHint.text: This note stays with the file. The agent reads it when you press Sweep.
commentTiedHint.short: The agent reads this when you press Sweep
commentTiedHint.note: Hint under the comment box, explaining when the note is consumed.

commentSaveLabel.note: Button that commits the comment box.

sweepHint.text: Finish this batch: apply your decisions, review what changed, note anything else it affects, and line up the next files
sweepHint.note: Tooltip on Sweep — the full list of what closing does.

foundingHeadTitle.note: Status strip under the project bar while the founding interview runs. Title Case as a hed (docs/UI.md); the term is lowercase in prose.

draftProposalLabel.text: Auto: let the Kettle agent decide
draftProposalLabel.note: Ends the founding interview early and writes the Desk Proposal.

draftProposalHint.text: Skip the rest of the questions and let the agent write the proposal now

skipFoundingLabel.text: Skip: open a blank project for now
skipFoundingLabel.note: Leaves founding for later and opens the project as-is.

skipFoundingHint.text: Set this up later — open the project now, with no files lined up
skipFoundingHint.note: Tooltip on skip for now. Names the cost (no charter, no queue) and how to resume.

sweepConfirmTitle.note: Hed of the sweep confirmation dialog.

sweepConfirmBody.text: Applies the decisions you marked, reviews what changed in each file, notes anything else it affects, saves a record of this round, and lines up the next batch.
sweepConfirmBody.short: Applies your decisions, reviews the batch, saves a record, and lines up the next files.
sweepConfirmBody.note: Body of the sweep confirmation — the authoritative description of what a sweep does.

sweepThrustPlaceholder.text: Anything on your mind as you finish? The agent reads this first (optional)
sweepThrustPlaceholder.note: Placeholder for the optional free-text steer on the sweep dialog.

addProjectNote.note: Body of the add-project dialog — sets up what happens after Start Interview.

addProjectStart.note: Button that registers the project and opens founding (P1 to P3). Title Case: docs/UI.md lists it among the signature actions that are also titles.

addProjectNamePlaceholder.note: Placeholder for the project's display name.

addProjectFoundingQuestion.text: What's the state of this project and how could a second reader help?
addProjectFoundingQuestion.note: The one mission question of registration (P1). Founding is a conversation, not a confirmation card — see docs/REVIEW.md.

addProjectFoundingPlaceholder.text: Example: "This project is growing quickly. Start by flagging anything that looks stale or contradictory."
addProjectFoundingPlaceholder.note: Example answer to the founding question. An example, not an instruction.

setupTitle.note: Hed of the first-run agent setup dialog.

setupNote.text: Pick the agent that runs setup, chat, and reviews. Kettle never stores keys. Sign in with your browser or set the API key in your shell.
setupNote.short: Pick the agent Kettle will run. Kettle never stores API keys.
setupNote.note: Body of first-run setup. The key promise (no stored keys) must survive any rewrite.

setupChecking.note: Placeholder status while first-run setup probes the selected CLI.

attached.full: Kettle has lined up a batch of files for you. Pick one to read it with the agent's summary. Mark your decisions as you go, then press Sweep when you are done.
attached.note: Shown wherever a viewport explains an open project desk with no file selected.

interviewing.short: Chat with the Kettle agent; when you are done it drafts a proposal to review.
interviewing.full: Chat with the Kettle agent to tell it what this project is and what you want from a second reader. When you are ready to proceed, the agent writes a proposal for you to review and edit. The queue fills after you approve the proposal.
interviewing.note: The founding interview (P3). Ends at the Auto control, not at Approve.

proposing.short: Edit the proposal, then approve it to set up your project.
proposing.full: The proposal is open in the editor. This is the document of record for your Kettle project. Read it, change anything that does not fit, and chat with the agent to revise or co-write.
proposing.note: A proposal is open and the project desk is not founded yet (P4). Replaces thirteen hand-written variants.

founding.full: The agent is setting up your project and lining up the first batch of files from your proposal. This may take a few minutes.

founded.short: Your project is ready. Pick a file to begin.
founded.full: Your project is set up and the first batch of files is ready. Pick one to read it with the agent's summary, edit and comment as you go, then press Sweep when you are done.

sweeping.short: Applying your decisions and lining up the next batch.
sweeping.full: The agent is applying your decisions, reviewing what changed, noting anything else it affects, saving a record of this round, and lining up the next batch.

broken.short: Kettle could not open this project. Nothing has been changed.
broken.full: Kettle could not open this project. Its folder may have moved, or its records may be unreadable. Nothing has been changed on disk. Check the project folder, or set the project up again — your own files are never touched.
broken.note: The project desk cannot be read. Never implies data loss: Kettle does not touch the user's files.
